Post a non-religious photo you think of as holy. "Gitche Gumee" is an Ojibwe term for Lake Superior that means "big sea" or "huge water." The Ojibwe name for the lake is gichi-gami, which is pronounced "gitchi-gami" or "kitchi-gami" in different dialects, and means "great sea".
